text: Now let's read a big number: six hundred and forty-five thousand and twenty-one. It has six places: hundred thousands, ten thousands, thousands, hundreds, tens and ones. The digit four is in the ten thousands place, so its value is forty thousand.

sentences.text: Now let's read a big number: six hundred and forty-five thousand and twenty-one.
It has six places: hundred thousands, ten thousands, thousands, hundreds, tens and ones.
The digit four is in the ten thousands place, so its value is forty thousand.
